mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_visitor (fingerprint, first_visit_time, last_visit_time) VALUES (#{fingerprint}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fingerprint = VALUES(fingerprint)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_visitor WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM blog_visitor WHERE visitor_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_visitor SET ip_address = #{row.ipAddress}, user_agent = #{row.userAgent}, country = #{row.country}, province = #{row.province}, city = #{row.city}, last_visit_time = GREATEST(first_visit_time, #{row.lastVisitTime}) WHERE visitor_id = #{row.visitorId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM blog_visitor WHERE blocked_ip_address = #{ip} AND is_blocked = 1 AND (blocked_until IS NULL OR blocked_until > #{now}) )
mapper.sql: SELECT v.visitor_id, v.fingerprint, v.ip_address, v.user_agent, v.country, v.province, v.city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_page_view pv WHERE pv.visitor_id = v.visitor_id) AS total_views, v.is_blocked, v.blocked_until, v.blocked_ip_address, v.first_visit_time, v.last_visit_time, v.create_time, v.update_time FROM blog_visitor v
